fact: Article 16 of the Executive Regulations (Decree No. 816 of 2025, issued 1 November 2025) requires a controller or processor to obtain a licence or permit from the Personal Data Protection Center, and the data subject's consent, before transferring personal data abroad.
title: Egypt Personal Data Protection Law - Executive Regulations (Decree No. 816 of 2025)
publisher: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (Al-Waqa'i' al-Misriyya supplement, English translation)
